Messages.Author: n...@ix.netcom.com
Messages.Body:
I've got two quick questions for everybody...

1) Is there anyway that anybody knows of to prevent damage to
reatiners in combat at long ranger? For example. if the minion
employing the retainer strike:dodges, does the damage on a targeted
retainer still occur?

2) On cards such as Bonecraft and Soul Burn that each do damage and
have a side effect (-1/-2 hand damage or weapons do no damage), if the
damage is prevented by some means, does the side effect still occur
(i.e. is the strike still considered to be succesfsful for this
purpose)?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <32b4363e...@nntp.ix.netcom.com>,

n...@ix.netcom.com wrote:
>
> 1) Is there anyway that anybody knows of to prevent damage to
> reatiners in combat at long ranger? For example. if the minion
> employing the retainer strike:dodges, does the damage on a targeted
> retainer still occur?

Only causing the damage to remain unresolved, or by setting the
damage dealt to zero. (Strike: Combat Ends, Destroy Weapon with First
Strike, a (non-existent?) ranged version of blood rage, etc.)

Dodge will not prevent damage that targets a retainer.

> 2) On cards such as Bonecraft and Soul Burn that each do damage and
> have a side effect (-1/-2 hand damage or weapons do no damage), if the
> damage is prevented by some means, does the side effect still occur
> (i.e. is the strike still considered to be succesfsful for this
> purpose)?

Yes. Only dodging the strike as a whole (or ending combat) will prevent
the other parts of the strike's effect.
